construction: homogeneousSpectatorPolynomial P gamma = rename Sum.inl P * rename Sum.inr (monomial (Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm gamma) 1), over variable type sigma + Fin d. Sigma may be Fin 3 for the KS consumer; no finiteness hypothesis on sigma is needed for this finite polynomial lemma.
exact_results: Evaluation at Sum.elim X s equals eval X P times product_i s_i^(gamma_i).
If P is homogeneous of degree m, the output is homogeneous of degree m + sum_i gamma_i.
The actual coefficient L1 norm of the output is at most the actual coefficient L1 norm of P.
The supporting generic lemma proves arbitrary renaming is nonexpansive for the actual coefficient L1 norm, using the previously proved substitution theorem and literal unit-norm polynomial variables.
semantic_checks: The finite spectator function gamma is converted by the actual Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite inverse, so its monomial has exactly those exponents.
Sum.inl and Sum.inr represent independent physical and spectator coordinate blocks. The exact evaluation formula reads those blocks through Sum.elim.
Homogeneity uses the actual Finsupp degree, and that degree is the sum of the specified spectator exponents.
The norm bound uses actual multiplication submultiplicativity and the actual monomial coefficient 1, whose coefficient norm is one. No unspecified polynomial norm is introduced.
Zero dimension is included: the empty spectator monomial is the constant one and its exponent sum is zero. Zero P and degree zero are included.
